en: 1 Chronicles 22

p.src: 1  Then David said, “This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”

p.src: 2  David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.

zh: 衛吩咐聚集住以色列地的外邦人，從其中派石匠鑿石頭，要建造
en: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.

p.src: 3  David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,

zh: 鐵做門上的釘子和鉤子，又預備許多銅，多得無法可稱；
en: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,

en: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.

p.src: 5  David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.

zh: 必須高大輝煌，使名譽榮耀傳遍萬國；所以我要為殿預備材料。」於是，大衛在未死之先預備的材料甚多。
en: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.

p.src: 6  Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.

en: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.
u.src: 6  Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.

p.src: 7  David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of the LORD my God.

zh: 對所羅門說：「我兒啊，我心裏本想為
en: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of the LORD my God.

p.src: 8  But the LORD’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.

zh: 只是耶和華的話臨到我說：『
血，打了多次大仗，你不可為
en: But the LORD’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.

p.src: 9  Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

p.src: 10  He shall build a house for my name; and he will be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’

zh: 子；我要作他的父。他作以色列王；我必堅定他的國位，直到永遠。』
en: He shall build a house for my name; and he will be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’

p.src: 11  Now, my son, may the LORD be with you and prosper you, and build the house of the LORD your God, as he has spoken concerning you.

zh: 同在，使你亨通，照他指着你說的話，建造
en: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you and prosper you, and build the house of the LORD your God, as he has spoken concerning you.
u.src: 11  Now, my son, may the LORD be with you and prosper you, and build the house of the LORD your God, as he has spoken concerning you.

p.src: 12  May the LORD give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of the LORD your God.

zh: 聰明智慧，好治理以色列國，
en: May the LORD give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of the LORD your God.
u.src: 12  May the LORD give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of the LORD your God.

p.src: 13  Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which the LORD gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.

zh: 亨通。你當剛強壯膽，不要懼怕，
en: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which the LORD gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.
u.src: 13  Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which the LORD gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.

p.src: 14  Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for the LORD’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.

en: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for the LORD’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.
u.src: 14  Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for the LORD’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.

en:
22:14 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces, so 100,000 talents is about 3 metric tons
22:14 about 30,000 metric tons

zh: 現在你們應當立定心意，尋求耶和華－你們的神；也當起來建造耶和華上帝的聖所，好將耶和華的約櫃和供奉上帝的聖器皿都搬進為耶和華名建造的殿裏。」
